extracted.intended_audience: new contributors / developers who want to contribute code to SymPy (Python open-source project)
extracted.subtask_description: A short guide for new contributors describing the necessary setup, development workflow, testing, and documentation-building steps needed to contribute code to the SymPy project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setup Development Environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Section intended as the starting point for people who have never contributed to an open source project before.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have never contributed to an open source project before, start with Setup Development Environment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development Workflow Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Section describing the development workflow contributors should follow; targeted at those already familiar with git and GitHub but new to SymPy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are already familiar with the basics of how to use git and GitHub, but you have never contributed to SymPy before, start with Development Workflow Process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing Tests
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how to write tests for contributions to SymPy (listed as a top-level section in the guide).

rubrics_metrics.name: Building the Documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions and requirements for building the SymPy documentation (listed as a top-level section in the guide).

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose starting path based on contributor experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Routing advice for new contributors: directs absolute newcomers to the environment setup section and those with git/GitHub experience to the workflow section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide is split into sections based on how experienced you are with open source. Use the section appropriate to your experience level as the starting point.
